prompt: Order the body of the deferred function in a panic-recovery middleware. It must ignore the no-panic case, let `http.ErrAbortHandler` pass through, report the rest and answer 500 if nothing was sent yet. One line is a decoy.
explain: `recover()` returns nil when there was no panic. `ErrAbortHandler` is the server's own signal, so it is re-panicked. A 500 is only possible while nothing has been written to the client yet.
